summary.title: Belgian spin-off Noak raises €5 million for perovskite-silicon solar cells
summary.main_point: Noak, a spin-off from imec and Hasselt University, has secured €5 million in seed funding to industrialize perovskite-silicon tandem solar technology.
bullets: The funding was provided by the Helios Foundation, Nuhma, and V2HFin.
The company utilizes intellectual property developed over a decade of research at the Institute for Materials Research.

summary.title: Retractable photovoltaics for wastewater treatment
summary.main_point: A 2.745 MW retractable solar roof is under construction at a wastewater treatment plant in Stuttgart-Mühlhausen, Germany.
bullets: The system will feature 5,280 photovoltaic modules covering 17,493 m2.
The installation consists of 120 retractable sections suspended from steel cables, with completion expected in the second quarter of 2027.

summary.title: Solar manufacturing updates in India and Indonesia
summary.main_point: Solarworld Energy Solutions acquired a 50% stake in a manufacturing joint venture, while Yingfa Ruineng launched a new facility in Indonesia.
bullets: Solarworld Energy Solutions acquired a 50% stake in Rays Green Energy Manufacturing for ₹268.2 million (Mercom India).
Yingfa Ruineng launched a 7.5GW TOPCon solar cell manufacturing plant in Indonesia (PV Tech).

summary.title: Envision claims world first with 800 V DC architecture for AI data center
summary.main_point: Envision Energy has deployed an integrated 800 V DC power system combining solid-state transformers and battery storage at its Galaxy AI data center.
bullets: The system uses the Dubhe Controller to coordinate power supply with computing demand in real time.
The technology converts 10 kV medium voltage to an 800 V DC bus.

summary.title: Japan proposes 50-metric-ton trigger for solar panel recycling plans
summary.main_point: Japan’s Ministry of the Environment and Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI) have proposed that owners of commercial solar installations planning to dispose of 50 metric tons (MT) or more of panels be required to file an advance disposal plan.

summary.title: Jigar Shah on the shift to battery-first energy and virtual power plants
summary.main_point: Residential battery storage is increasingly being utilized for grid capacity management rather than solely for emergency backup.
bullets: Energy demand from data centers, electric vehicles, and industrial facilities is driving the evolution of virtual power plants.
Traditional solar installers are being encouraged to adapt to a battery-first market.

summary.title: Solar sector corporate funding increases 45% through three quarters of 2026
summary.main_point: Global solar sector corporate funding reached $25.1 billion across 170 deals in the first nine months of 2026, according to Mercom Capital Group.
bullets: This represents a 45% year-over-year increase compared to the $17.3 billion raised in the first nine months of 2025.
Debt financing accounted for $20.4 billion of the total funding, marking a 61% increase.

summary.title: Trump bulk power equipment ban sparks industry pushback
summary.main_point: A 26 August executive order from US President Donald Trump banning certain foreign-made power equipment has caused concern within the energy storage industry.
bullets: The order targets bulk power equipment imports.
The industry has responded with public comment and private concern.

summary.title: Behind-the-meter generation could provide more grid relief than data center load shifting
summary.main_point: An Ember analysis suggests that behind-the-meter generation and storage offer significantly more grid flexibility potential for data centers than load shifting.
bullets: Load shifting is limited by the low latency requirements of cloud services, enterprise workloads, and artificial intelligence inference.
The study examined nine markets across the United States, Europe, and Southeast Asia.

summary.title: Vastly different fortunes for BESS in Belgium and Germany’s capacity market auctions
summary.main_point: Battery storage projects have won nearly 40% of the capacity in Belgium’s latest capacity market (CM) auction results, while Germany’s first has all gone to gas, paying nearly eight times more than Belgium in the process.

summary.title: Germany awards 288 MW of solar in rooftop tender
summary.main_point: The Federal Network Agency awarded 288 MW of PV capacity across 143 projects at a volume-weighted average price of €0.0967/kWh.
bullets: A total of 177 bids totaling 347 MW were submitted, with 34 bids totaling 58 MW excluded.
Awarded prices ranged from €0.10/kWh to €0.085/kWh.
The average award price was higher than the July tender, which stood at €0.0972/kWh.

summary.title: Rayzon Solar on track for December 2026 TOPCon cell plant opening
summary.main_point: Rayzon Solar is set to begin production at its 5.1 GW TOPCon solar cell facility in December 2026.
bullets: Initial deliveries from the new facility are expected in the first quarter of 2027.
The company currently has an installed solar module manufacturing capacity of 11.3 GW.

summary.title: RenewSys signs 1.2 GW supply deal with Kosol Energie
summary.main_point: RenewSys India will supply POE encapsulants and backsheets to Kosol Energie for 1.2 GW of solar modules over a twelve-month period.
bullets: The materials will support the production of high-efficiency n-type TOPCon modules at Kosol Energie's facility in Gujarat.

summary.title: Waaree Renewable Technologies secures BESS and solar contracts
summary.main_point: Waaree Renewable Technologies has been awarded an EPC contract for a 200 MW/500 MWh BESS project and a five-year O&M agreement for a 360 MWp solar project.
bullets: The BESS project is scheduled for completion during the financial year 2027-28.
Engie has separately commissioned 450 MW of solar projects in India, including the 250 MW Khaba project and 200 MW Khavda project.

summary.title: Waaree doubles Texas solar module manufacturing capacity to 3.2 GW
summary.main_point: Waaree Solar Americas has increased its Brookshire, Texas, manufacturing capacity to 3.2 GW following the start of production on two new 800 MW lines.
bullets: The company expects its total US module manufacturing capacity to reach 4.8 GW in fiscal 2027.
Waaree's global module order book exceeds 25 GW.

summary.title: DTE Energy and sonnen launch VPP pilot in Michigan
summary.main_point: DTE Energy and sonnen have launched a two-year virtual power plant pilot connecting nearly 100 homes in an all-electric community.
bullets: The project is located at Veridian at County Farm, a development featuring 170 mixed-income homes.
The pilot was approved by the Michigan Public Service Commission.

summary.title: Nova Scotia opens technology-neutral capacity call to replace coal
summary.main_point: The Nova Scotia Independent Energy System Operator has launched a request for qualifications for on-demand capacity to support the phase-out of coal by 2030.
bullets: Eligible technologies include battery storage, pumped hydro, long-duration storage, geothermal, biomass, thermal generation, hydrogen combustion, hydrogen fuel cells, small modular reactors, and hybrid facilities.

summary.title: IB Solar signs MoU for 2GW TOPCon cell manufacturing line in India
summary.main_point: IB Solar has partnered with three German companies to develop a 2GW TOPCon solar cell manufacturing facility in India.
bullets: The project involves the development of a 2GW TOPCon solar cell manufacturing line and an R&D centre.

summary.title: Revolta installs first 10 kWh sodium-ion home battery in Germany
summary.main_point: Frankfurt-based Revolta has commissioned its first sodium-ion home battery system at a residential property in Germany.
bullets: The system operates at a nominal voltage of 450 V and consists of five battery modules totaling 10 kWh.
The property features an existing 20 kW solar PV array and a small hydroelectric plant.

summary.title: Return secures €835 million financing for German BESS rollout
summary.main_point: BESS operator Return has obtained €835 million in portfolio financing to support its battery energy storage system expansion in Germany.
bullets: The financing was underwritten by Deutsche Bank and Rabobank.
Return aims to deploy 1GW of BESS capacity annually.

summary.title: NHPC invites bids for battery storage projects in Uttar Pradesh
summary.main_point: NHPC has issued a tender for battery energy storage systems and solar-plus-storage power supply at the Jalaun Solar Park.
bullets: The project is located in the state of Uttar Pradesh.

summary.title: China’s energy storage capacity reaches 167 GW
summary.main_point: China's operational new-type energy storage capacity grew to 167 GW/435 GWh by the end of September 2026.
bullets: Capacity increased by 63% year on year, with a net addition of approximately 31 GW/84 GWh in the first nine months of 2026.
Average storage duration rose to 2.61 hours, and equivalent utilization hours reached 915 hours for the nine-month period.

summary.title: Hoymiles plans to establish inverter factory in Oman
summary.main_point: Hoymiles has signed a strategic agreement to explore local manufacturing and renewable energy investment in Oman.
bullets: The agreement includes plans to establish the Oman New Energy Ecosystem Cooperation Fund.
The fund will target distributed solar, energy storage, and power solutions for AI data centers.

summary.title: ARRAY Technologies and Shoals plan to merge
summary.main_point: ARRAY Technologies and Shoals Technologies Group have agreed to merge in an all-stock transaction to create an integrated solar hardware platform.
bullets: The transaction is valued at approximately $1.32 billion (pv magazine USA).
The merger combines ARRAY’s structural tracking and racking systems with Shoals’ electrical balance-of-system solutions.

summary.title: Solar carport project completed at California medical plaza
summary.main_point: Watthub Renewables and Sunrock Distributed Generation have installed a 322-kW solar carport system at a medical office building in Irvine, California.
bullets: The solar modules cover approximately 108 parking spots.
The system serves as the building's primary source of electricity.

summary.title: “Speed to power runs through the community”
summary.main_point: During a keynote interview at pv magazine USA Week 2026 , Nick de Vries, chief technology officer of Silicon Ranch, examined why solar and storage account for over 90% of U.S.

summary.title: Soluxtec resumes TOPCon solar module production in Germany
summary.main_point: German manufacturer Soluxtec has restarted production at its Trier-Föhren facility using TOPCon technology following an acquisition by Ronmaa.
bullets: The facility has transitioned from M10 to G12-format cells.
Production will be ramped up gradually, though annual capacity was not disclosed.
IB Solar has signed an MoU with three German firms to develop a 2GW TOPCon cell manufacturing line in India (PV Tech).

summary.title: Third Latvian solar PV plant from Ignitis Renewables enters operations
summary.main_point: The 174MW Tume solar farm in Tukums, Latvia, has reached operational status.
bullets: This project marks the first time owner Ignitis Renewables will operate its own facility.

summary.title: Laser-based recycling method enables over 95% selective silver recovery
summary.main_point: Researchers have developed a laser-induced delamination process to separate EVA from aged solar modules, facilitating material recovery.
bullets: The method targets the EVA–Si interface to provide a dry pathway for removing encapsulants.
The process aims to reduce material intermixing compared to traditional shredding or thermal treatment.

summary.title: Chinese and Indian solar manufacturers report financial results
summary.main_point: Several solar manufacturers reported mixed financial results, with JA and Longi seeing revenue declines and Saatvik Green reporting a profit drop.
bullets: JA reported a net loss of CNY 3.64 billion for the first nine months of 2026 (pv magazine).
Longi reported revenue of CNY 43.864 billion for the first nine months of 2026 (pv magazine).
Saatvik Green Energy's profit after tax fell 76.2% year-over-year to ₹202 million in the second quarter of fiscal year 2027 (Mercom India).

summary.title: India renewable energy capacity and procurement update
summary.main_point: Government agencies in India auctioned 12 GW of renewable energy capacity in the third quarter of 2026.
bullets: Battery energy storage and hybrid projects accounted for 45.2% of the auctioned capacity (Mercom India).
India added 55.3 GW of non-fossil capacity during fiscal year 2025–26 (pv magazine India).

summary.title: Sodium-ion battery technology approaches commercial production phase
summary.main_point: Sodium-ion batteries are emerging as a stationary storage alternative with over 70 GWh in supply agreements already in place.
bullets: Cell-level cost parity with LFP batteries is expected by late 2026.
Parity at the module and system levels is not anticipated until after 2030.
BYD plans to reach 30 GWh of sodium-ion battery capacity.

summary.title: Earnings roundup: Sunrun, SolarEdge, Shoals, Array Technologies, FTC Solar report Q3 numbers
summary.main_point: As Q3 2026 earnings season continues, a number of public solar companies have made announcements in recent days.

summary.title: Faropoint begins construction on New Jersey community solar project
summary.main_point: Faropoint has started building a 1.6-MW community solar installation in Fair Lawn, New Jersey.
bullets: This project is the first of 16 planned installations in the state.
The total capacity for all 16 projects is expected to exceed 10 MW.

summary.title: “Moving into a positive political environment for solar” – is the ITC coming back?
summary.main_point: Even before the midterm election results, Roth Capital’s Philip Shen, managing director and senior research analyst, had been hearing that the solar tax credit was still on the minds of many in Washington D.C.

summary.title: Researchers develop 10.56 kW solar-powered pleasure boat
summary.main_point: A research team from Canada’s Memorial University of Newfoundland has designed a solar-electric propulsion system for a pleasure boat.
bullets: The system is designed for an 11.8-meter-long, 5.8-meter-wide boat that can accommodate five to six adults.
The design process utilized a two-stage evaluation method combining HOMER Pro energy yield estimates with MATLAB/Simulink dynamic modeling.

summary.title: Study finds 0.5-meter spacing between solar module rows improves cooling in floating PV systems
summary.main_point: A computational fluid dynamics study indicates that 0.5-meter spacing between module rows optimizes cooling for floating solar installations.
bullets: At a wind speed of 3.5 m/s, the 0.5-meter spacing achieved an average module temperature of 27.16 C, compared to 31.07 C for the most compact arrangement.
Under 1.5 m/s wind conditions, the optimal configuration recorded an average module temperature of 37.02 C.
Crystalline silicon PV module efficiency typically drops by 0.3% to 0.5% for every 1 C increase in cell temperature.

summary.title: Norwegian central bank buys US$300 million stake in Aypa Power
summary.main_point: Norges Bank Investment Management has acquired a 10% interest in the North American battery storage developer Aypa Power.
bullets: The investment is valued at US$300 million.

summary.title: India’s solar PV capacity and manufacturing growth
summary.main_point: India is projected to expand its solar and renewable energy capacity significantly by 2030.
bullets: The IEA forecasts India's solar PV capacity will exceed 350 GW by 2030 (pv magazine).
Total renewable power capacity is expected to reach around 530 GW by 2030, with wind at 90 GW and hydropower at 75 GW (pv magazine).
The Ministry of New and Renewable Energy has added 2.13 GW of solar cell manufacturing capacity to the Approved List (Mercom India).

summary.title: Portable solar-powered system produces 1.64 liters of drinking water in 8 hours
summary.main_point: Researchers at Soochow University developed a portable device that uses electrothermal evaporation to produce clean water from contaminated sources.
bullets: The prototype produced 1.64 liters of water in eight hours using an evaporation surface of 30.72 cm2.
The device features an interlayer electrothermal evaporator that positions the heating element within the structure to reduce heat loss.

summary.title: Avantus upsizes corporate credit facility to $1.28 billion
summary.main_point: Utility-scale solar and energy storage developer Avantus has increased its corporate credit facility commitments to $1.28 billion.
bullets: Avantus operates as a developer, owner, and operator of utility-scale solar and energy storage projects.

summary.title: New York funds energy storage projects and Ford Energy partners with DESRI
summary.main_point: New York State has awarded funding for energy storage advancement, while Ford Energy and DESRI have announced a partnership.
bullets: New York’s Power Generation and Storage Innovation program awarded nearly $13 million to 15 projects (Solar Power World).
Ford Energy and D. E. Shaw Renewable Investments (DESRI) will partner to deploy energy storage in the US (Energy-Storage.news).

summary.title: U.S. solar developers navigate policy stack as Section 232 deadline nears
summary.main_point: U.S. solar equipment inventories grew by 126% in the second quarter of 2026 as developers prepared for upcoming trade regulations.
bullets: Industry activity has been influenced by the July 4 construction-start deadline, the July 24 tariff transition, and Foreign Entity of Concern restrictions.

summary.title: Democratic sweep in US midterms brings reprieve for solar, but federal gridlock persists
summary.main_point: PV Tech spoke with many industry experts about the midterm election results, covering topics such as permitting, state-level impact and investment appetite.

summary.title: Government plans to freeze gas prices in 2027
summary.main_point: The Ministry of Energy has published draft legislation to freeze gas prices for eligible consumers at 197,27 PLN per MWh in 2027.
bullets: The proposed price freeze level matches the myOrlen tariff approved by the regulator until the end of 2026.
The basic BASE instrument for 2027 on the Towarowa Giełda Energii is valued at 324 PLN per MWh.
The draft assumptions propose extending gas price tariffing for households and sensitive consumers until the end of 2030, instead of the current end of 2027 deadline.
Minister Miłosz Motyka estimates the cost of the intervention at approximately 6 billion PLN.

summary.title: Solarwatt launches new bifacial TOPCon BIPV module
summary.main_point: Solarwatt has released the Panel vision M 5.0 construct, a bifacial TOPCon module for building-integrated photovoltaic applications.
bullets: The module received general building authority approval from the German Institute for Construction Technology.
The product is intended for use in carports, parking canopies, facades, and green roof applications.

summary.title: French winter temperatures impact regional electricity exports
summary.main_point: Each degree of cold in France reduces net electricity exports by approximately 1 GW and increases day-ahead prices in France, Belgium, and Germany.
bullets: Price increases range from €5/MWh to €7/MWh during cold spells.
French temperature fluctuations account for half of the French price response, one-third of the Belgian response, and one-quarter of the German response.

summary.title: Corporate renewable power purchase agreements decline in 2026
summary.main_point: Corporate power purchase agreements in Europe have secured 5.9 GW of renewable capacity so far in 2026, representing a 9.7% decrease compared to the same period last year.
bullets: The 10th edition of the RE-Source event in Amsterdam hosted over 350 corporate energy buyers.
The event facilitated approximately 400 prescheduled meetings between buyers and suppliers.

summary.title: Terra Clean invites bids for solar project transformers
summary.main_point: Terra Clean, a subsidiary of Indian Oil Corporation, has issued a tender for the supply of power transformers for solar projects in Madhya Pradesh and Gujarat.
bullets: The transformers are intended for solar park projects.

summary.title: African Development Bank invests in Egyptian solar project
summary.main_point: The African Development Bank signed a $66 million financing agreement for the first phase of the Dandara solar-plus-storage project in Egypt.
bullets: $46 million is sourced from ordinary Bank Group resources.
$20 million is provided as concessional funding from the Climate Investment Funds’ Clean Technology Fund.

summary.title: Karnataka Power Corporation tenders solar-plus-storage project
summary.main_point: Karnataka Power Corporation has issued a tender for a ground-mounted solar project integrated with a battery energy storage system.
bullets: The project involves a ground-mounted solar installation combined with battery storage.

summary.title: Community solar and large-scale projects reach milestones
summary.main_point: ECA Power energized a 7.4-MWDC community solar project in Illinois, while a 1.2 GW solar project in Texas secured a $1.8 billion green loan.
bullets: The Texas project, Big Rooter Power, is being built on 1,804 hectares of reclaimed coal mine land.
The first phase of the Texas project loan is $769 million, with a second phase exceeding $1 billion.

summary.title: Report finds distributed energy resources could save US power system $614 billion
summary.main_point: A study by The Brattle Group indicates that removing barriers to distributed energy resources could save the US power system $614 billion by 2050.
bullets: Distributed solar capacity is projected to grow from 68 GW today to 230 GW by 2050.
Savings are expected from the growth of distributed solar, distributed storage, and demand flexibility technologies.

summary.title: Solar and storage companies support federal permitting reform
summary.main_point: Hundreds of solar and storage companies have signed a letter to Congress supporting the Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act of 2026.
bullets: The legislation is intended to facilitate the construction of energy projects to help lower energy costs.

summary.title: Ecoprogetti deploys solar module recycling plant in Italy
summary.main_point: Ecoprogetti has delivered an automated solar module recycling line to Haiki+ Group in Sale, Italy, which has been operational since early 2025.
bullets: The recycling line can process up to 120 solar panels per hour, or approximately 4 tonnes per hour.
The system has a nominal potential of around 700,000 tonnes annually if operated continuously.
The plant currently maintains an uptime of 94%.

summary.title: Romania’s renewable project pipeline surpasses 114 GW
summary.main_point: Romania has 1,625 renewable energy projects larger than 1 MW with valid grid connection permits, totaling 114.9 GW of approved export capacity.
bullets: As of October 1, 1,055 projects have signed connection contracts, totaling 63.7 GW of capacity.
A total of 749 projects have obtained building permits, while 262 projects have received establishment authorisations.
The number of projects with valid grid connection permits fell by 1.1% compared to the start of September.

summary.title: Italy: RWE and BNZ launch construction on large-scale battery projects
summary.main_point: RWE and BNZ have announced the start of construction on battery energy storage system projects in Italy with a combined capacity of nearly 500MWh.
bullets: The projects are described as large-scale battery energy storage systems.

summary.title: SECI and NHPC invite bids for solar and storage projects
summary.main_point: The Solar Energy Corporation of India and NHPC Ltd have issued separate tenders for rooftop solar and battery energy storage system projects.
bullets: SECI is seeking developers for rooftop solar projects on New Delhi Municipal Council buildings.
NHPC is seeking developers for battery energy storage systems at the 1.2 GW Jalaun Solar Park, with two configuration options for solar-plus-storage scheduling.

summary.title: Terra Clean tenders transmission infrastructure for renewable projects
summary.main_point: Terra Clean has invited bids for engineering, procurement, and construction contractors to develop transmission infrastructure for renewable energy projects.
bullets: The scope includes design, supply, construction, and commissioning of pooling substations and extra high voltage transmission lines.
The infrastructure will support interstate and intrastate transmission system-connected solar, wind, and hybrid projects.

summary.title: Huaneng commissions dual-flywheel frequency regulation system
summary.main_point: Huaneng Group has commissioned a 5.5 MW, 1.375 MWh dual-flywheel frequency regulation system at its Lanzhou power plant.
bullets: The primary 5 MW, 1.25 MWh flywheel unit is claimed to be the highest-power single flywheel unit in China.
The system achieves a grid response time below 100 milliseconds and a regulation accuracy above 99.5%.

summary.title: Senate advances federal energy permitting bill
summary.main_point: The Senate is fast tracking legislation that would reduce permitting times for energy projects, but possibly to the detriment of longstanding policies protecting the environment.

summary.title: Solar O&M hiring surges as job market demands broad technical skills
summary.main_point: An analysis of U.S. solar job listings shows that while 84% of operations and maintenance job descriptions require electrical skills, only 9% mandate an electrician license.
bullets: Data from the Interstate Renewable Energy Council indicates that 23% of operations and maintenance employers reported severe difficulty in finding qualified workers in 2024.

summary.title: Qcells US modules first to pass all reliability tests from Kiwa PVEL and RETC
summary.main_point: Qcells has passed all evaluation categories in module reliability tests conducted by Kiwa PVEL and the Renewable Energy Test Center (RETC) for US-made solar modules.

summary.title: The PPA market has a flexibility problem, hybrid PPAs are part of the answer
summary.main_point: Hybrid power purchase agreements combining solar with wind or storage are increasingly needed to address market cannibalisation and the limitations of solar-only contracts.
bullets: Simple 10-year, pay-as-produced solar PPAs remain in use for buyers seeking long-term price references.
Increased solar penetration has led to generation concentration and price cannibalisation.
Hybrid PPAs offer a power profile that better matches actual consumption and provides more predictable costs.

summary.title: Paris leads EU capitals for rooftop solar generation potential
summary.main_point: Rooftop PV can make a substantial contribution to urban electricity supply across each of the EU’s 27 capital cities, according to new research.

summary.title: SpaceX orders HJT solar cell manufacturing equipment from Singulus Technologies
summary.main_point: Singulus Technologies has secured a contract to supply solar cell production equipment to SpaceX.
bullets: The order is for heterojunction (HJT) solar cell manufacturing equipment.

summary.title: Solar tracker adoption in India could reach 70% in five years
summary.main_point: Single-axis solar tracker adoption in India's utility-scale market is expected to grow significantly, while Polycab India has reached a milestone in inverter shipments.
bullets: Single-axis solar tracker adoption is expected to rise to nearly 60% to 70% over the next three to five years (Mercom India).
Polycab India Ltd has shipped 6 GW of inverters, totaling more than 11 lakh units (pv magazine India).
Polycab inverters account for 30% of total rooftop solar installations under the PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana (pv magazine India).

summary.title: CASC completes maiden flight of solar-powered UAV in China
summary.main_point: The 11th Research Institute of CASC successfully conducted the first flight of its Light Cavalry solar-powered UAV on Nov. 11.
bullets: The UAV features an 8-meter wingspan, a maximum takeoff weight of 45 kg, and a payload capacity exceeding 5 kg.
Design targets include continuous operation for up to 30 hours at altitudes up to 7,000 meters.
The aircraft can be launched from a vehicle without a runway and requires 20 minutes of ground preparation.

summary.title: RelyEZ debuts on HKEX Main Board
summary.main_point: RelyEZ has listed its shares on the Main Board of The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited.
bullets: The company provides energy storage system solutions.

summary.title: Heliene and Caelux combine PV cells and solar glass for a hybrid module
summary.main_point: Heliene and Caelux Corporation have commenced commercial production of a hybrid-tandem solar module for the US market.
bullets: The module integrates Caelux perovskite glass with Heliene silicon N-type cells.
The product places two energy-generating sources into a single solar panel.

summary.title: Connecticut completes 1.4 MW solar project at state Veterans Affairs campus
summary.main_point: Connecticut has completed two solar installations totaling 1.404 MW DC at the Department of Veterans Affairs campus in Rocky Hill.
bullets: The projects are expected to generate approximately 1.84 million kWh of electricity annually.
The installations are estimated to provide $2.2 million in direct energy cost savings over a 20-year lifecycle.
The systems were developed under the Connecticut Green Bank’s Solar Marketplace Assistance Program Plus.

summary.title: Lunar Energy introduces updated Lunar System and new bidirectional EV charger
summary.main_point: Lunar Energy announced a next-generation battery system and a new bidirectional EV charger.
bullets: The new battery system allows for 30 kWh of storage per stack, with the ability to parallel up to ten stacks.
The updated hybrid inverter offers 13.4 kW of continuous power output, compared to 9.6 kW in the previous model.
The system supports 185 locked rotor amps of motor-starting current.

summary.title: PV ModuleTech Europe 2026 discussions focus on testing and procurement
summary.main_point: Key topics at PV ModuleTech Europe 2026 included module testing challenges, the role of BESS, and the procurement landscape.
bullets: Module testing challenges, BESS, and procurement were identified as primary discussion points at the event.

summary.title: Sweden plans new inverter and battery database for 2027
summary.main_point: Energiföretagen Sverige is preparing to launch a digital database called Rikta Rätt 2.0 in 2027 to provide technical information on solar and battery inverters.
bullets: The database will replace the existing list of pre-assessed inverters to assist distribution system operators with grid connection applications.
Inclusion in the database will not constitute an official approval or proof of compliance with technical requirements.

summary.title: Chasing the sun: Feasible CO₂ supply as a gateway to low-cost e-fuel production
summary.main_point: Producing fuels from captured CO 2 requires large amounts of renewable electricity, yet major carbon sources and the best wind or solar sites are often far apart.

summary.title: India’s Solar Capacity Rises 21% YoY in 9M Despite Cell Shortages
summary.main_point: India installed 27.3 GW of large-scale solar capacity in the first nine months (9M) of the calendar year (CY) 2026, up 21% year-over-year (YoY) compared to 22.5 GW, according to Mercom India Research’s newly released 9M and Q3 2026 India Solar Market Update Report.

summary.title: Odisha proposes 4% energy storage obligation by 2030
summary.main_point: The Odisha Electricity Regulatory Commission has proposed increasing the renewable purchase obligation to 43.33% and adding a 4% energy storage obligation by financial year 2030.
bullets: The proposed regulations aim to integrate higher levels of renewable energy and storage capacity by financial year 2030.

summary.title: Octopus Energy launches $600 million fund for Asian renewables
summary.main_point: Octopus Energy has launched a $600 million fund to support clean energy projects in Asia, with an initial investment in a Philippine solar and storage developer.
bullets: The fund is backed by $50 million from Japanese investors.
The first investment in Octali Energy Development targets 450 MW of solar and 350 MWh of battery storage in the Philippines by 2030.

summary.title: Lydian Energy brings 600 MWh Utah battery system online
summary.main_point: Lydian Energy's 150 MW/600 MWh Faraday battery energy storage system in Utah has reached commercial operation and is supporting a Meta data center.
bullets: The system has been in commercial operation since Sept. 18.
The project provides storage capacity to PacifiCorp and supports Meta’s Eagle Mountain data center under a specific utility tariff.

summary.title: Connecticut completes 1.4 MW solar project for Veterans Affairs
summary.main_point: Connecticut has completed two solar installations totaling 1.404 MW DC at the Department of Veterans Affairs campus in Rocky Hill.
bullets: The projects are projected to generate approximately 1.84 million kWh of electricity annually.
The installations are estimated to save $2.2 million in energy costs over a 20-year lifecycle.

summary.title: DC bidirectional charging and data centre demand are reshaping the case for US DERs
summary.main_point: As data centre demand surges, utilities and developers are turning to distributed energy resources (DERs) to ease grid strain.
